_: ⭐⭐⭐ ITEM 7, THE `ta.valuewhen` HALF — ALL FOUR QUESTIONS ANSWERED. 381 corpus sites ride on question 4, and it is INCLUSIVE.

Q4_occurrence_zero_includes_the_current_.verdict: INCLUSIVE — occurrence 0 is the most recent firing COUNTING THIS BAR
Q4_occurrence_zero_includes_the_current_._: ⭐⭐ A PERFECT SPLIT ON THE ONLY BARS THAT CAN SETTLE IT. Inclusive and exclusive AGREE on every bar where the condition is false — so those bars are worthless as evidence, and a naive comparison across all 610 would have looked like agreement with both. The probe computes both oracles itself and marks the 122 bars where they DIFFER (`N05_DISCRIMINATING_BAR_only_here`); on every one of them the vendor answered the inclusive value and never the exclusive one.
Q4_occurrence_zero_includes_the_current_._whyThisWasTheExpensiveOne: `r11-time-and-valuewhen.md`: 'This is the single most likely place to be off by one, and 381 sites ride on it.' An off-by-one here produces a plausible-looking series that is wrong everywhere — the failure a green suite cannot see.

Q2_Q3_occurrences_count_FIRINGS.verdict: occurrence N is the Nth most recent FIRING, one per firing
Q2_Q3_occurrences_count_FIRINGS._: ⭐ THE CONDITION FIRES EVERY 5th BAR BY CONSTRUCTION (`bar_index % 5 == 0`), so if occurrences count firings the step is EXACTLY 5 — and 5 is the ONLY value either delta takes across 610 bars. Not 1 (which would mean occurrence counts bars), not a mixture (which would mean it counts something else). ⛔ The deltas are computed from the RAW occurrence values rather than plotted directly, because a delta compared against the wrong oracle hides a two-step error.

Q1_never_fired._: ⛔ `na`, NOT 0 — on every one of 610 bars. 0 would be the dangerous answer: a screen reading `valuewhen(cond, x, 0) > 0` would silently treat 'never happened' as a real value of zero. ⭐ The probe uses `bar_index < 0` rather than the literal `false` deliberately: it is ARITHMETIC, so it cannot be folded away before it is ever evaluated, which a literal might be.

_bounds: ⚠️ ONE SYMBOL, ONE TIMEFRAME, ONE CONDITION SHAPE. The condition fires on a fixed period (every 5th bar), which is what makes the oracle computable — but it means nothing here reads an IRREGULAR condition, two firings on consecutive bars, or an occurrence index beyond 2.
